name: Ursela Kuat's star yacht
description: At some point by 311 BBY, a star yacht carrying the principal director of the shipyard company Kuat Drive Yards, Ursela Kuat, was destroyed along the Rothana Route hyperlane by the gravity mines placed there to protect the Outer Rim Territories KDY shipyard planet Rothana. Decades later it was revealed that Kuat's rivals on the KDY directorate had secretly been behind the yacht's destruction and Kuat's death.
